result.summary: Found 1 significant visual issue: the promotional banner text is very low contrast and looks washed out. Partial carousel items and bottom-cut content were excluded per instructions.

issues.description: The green promotional banner's headline and subtext are white/very light on a pale mint background, making them hard to read and appearing faded or broken.
issues.suggestion: Darken the banner background or use darker text so the offer, code, and minimum-order details meet readable contrast.
